source: Can you make a 3d Parkour game where you keep doing colourful parkour higher and higher and if you fall just try again from the place you landed on also make it get harder the further up you get and make it so the parkour never ends and make it have like wallhops, dissapearing staircase when you walk on it, kill bricks and all sorts

answers.ask: How tall is one generated segment before it repeats? An endless tower has to be built as a repeating chunk rather than one map.
answers.answer: Use small repeating vertical segments, about 100 studs tall each, so the tower can keep generating above the player without needing a huge map.

answers.ask: If the climb never ends, is there anything to chase - a height record, a leaderboard - or is the height itself the whole game?
answers.answer: Add a height record and a simple leaderboard; the goal is to climb as high as possible.

config.genre_evidence: "3d Parkour game," "parkour higher and higher," "wallhops," "dissapearing staircase," and "kill bricks" describe a player-paced vertical obstacle course. It is endless and uses generated 100-stud vertical segments, but movement is not automatic, so Infinite Runner is only secondary.
config.evidence: "parkour higher and higher," "endless tower," "small repeating vertical segments... generating above the player," and "dissapearing staircase when you walk on it" explicitly call for a stacked vertical ascent with timed obstacles.
config.addendum:
LAYOUT FEATURES for this Obby & Platformer map. Build these as the actual structure of the space rather than as set dressing, keep them visually distinct from one another, and keep the whole layout legible in one view.

SHAPE OF THE SPACE - Tower / Spiral Ascent: A course wrapping or stacking so platforms sit directly above each other.

INCLUDE:
- Sequential Platform Track: A chain of platforms spaced to the physics limits above — the ordered route through the course.
- Timed Obstacles: Platforms that vanish after being stepped on, or a set time after activation.
- Climb Obstacles: Trusses, ladders, tightropes, and wall scrambles.
- End Reward Area: A distinct reward area at the end of the course holding the payoff items.
